difficulty_reason: Quasi-isomorphisms of bimodules may be tensored against good modules: reduces to showing the map of tensors is an isomorphism on cohomology sheaves, forms the cone N'' of N -> N' (noting it is a bimodule though not needed), identifies the cone of the map of tensors with P tensor N'' by functoriality, and concludes acyclicity from goodness of P and acyclicity of the cone on a quasi-isomorphism. Retained author proof at lines 4953-4974.
